settings.risk.label: Risk and your marks
settings.risk.body: How much an appointed role may settle here. At low and medium risk a role you appoint answers what its grants cover, held for your Overrule; at high risk none does, and every decision waits on you. A mark keeps one kind of act yours whatever the risk: this place’s production releases. Only you set this: an agent’s press of it goes on your card in every mode.
settings.risk.says.low: Low risk: a role you appoint settles what its grants cover, held for your Overrule.
settings.risk.says.medium: Medium risk: a role you appoint settles what its grants cover, held for your Overrule.
settings.risk.says.high: High risk: no role settles anything here; every decision waits on you.
settings.risk.saved: The risk and marks of {{name}} are saved.
